title: Off-Manifold Collapse in Guided Protein Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein language models are widely used priors for protein sequence design, and a growing body of work controls them at inference time as an alternative to fine-tuning. Such guidance faces a dilemma: mild enough to preserve natural activation statistics, it barely moves the property; strong enough to move it, the generations become progressively harder to fold. We show the failure has a specific and cheaply detectable signature, an off-manifold collapse of the model's own representations. Guided activations fall toward a region statistically indistinguishable from random amino-acid input, and the sequences degenerate to low complexity, yet the property oracle being optimized can still score these generations as a success. The optimized oracle can therefore fail to witness the collapse and, for solubility, can actively reward it, whereas structure and composition expose the failure. translated_title: 引导蛋白质语言模型中的离流形崩溃
translated_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型被广泛用作蛋白质序列设计的先验，越来越多的研究在推理时控制它们，作为微调的替代方案。这种引导面临一个两难困境：引导力度温和到足以保留自然的激活统计特性时，它几乎不改变目标属性；引导力度强到足以改变属性时，生成的序列逐渐变得难以折叠。我们表明，这种失败有一个具体且廉价可检测的特征，即模型自身表示的离流形崩溃。引导后的激活值落向一个与随机氨基酸输入在统计上无法区分的区域，序列退化为低复杂度，而被优化的属性预测器仍可将这些生成序列评为成功。因此，被优化的预测器可能无法察觉这种崩溃，并且对于溶解度，它甚至会积极奖励这种崩溃，而结构和组成则能暴露这一失败。由于这种失败在生成的最终样本中已经可见，因此可以及时检测。
tldr: 本文揭示了引导蛋白质语言模型在推理时可能发生离流形崩溃，导致生成序列难以折叠但被属性预测器误判为成功，并提出可通过模型表示统计特征廉价检测该失败。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that guided protein language models can undergo off-manifold collapse during inference, producing sequences that are hard to fold yet scored as successful by property oracles, and proposes a cheap detection method based on representation statistics.
